Optional taps require actual surviving wiring and calibration; local power still does not prove repair. obstruction: Construct damage-region observability and a complete repair, cooling and load-return operation, with surviving monitoring, calibrated material/gas/thermal behavior, disposition of consumed conductive stock and useful-function/life evidence. A refreshed layer or replacement cartridge remains paid input; disappearance of a short or an isolated pressure observation does not close functional restoration.
provides: Complete restoration must connect actual damage detection to local repair, retain or isolate mechanical/fluid loads, preserve healthy monitoring, cool to a bounded ready state and verify useful function. Missing material or consumed/reconfigured conductive stock needs real restoration or paid replacement. A new cartridge or externally refreshed layer is an input, not internal renewal. Ordinary sensing, isolation and proof loading remain existing candidate components.
requires: Locate the actual damaged region, retain or isolate mechanical/fluid loads, direct heat without destroying healthy monitoring, recover a bounded cool state and verify useful function and critical stocks. The circuit model assumes two series ohmic elements, fixed current and independent lumped thermal nodes. The gas model assumes ideal air, a declared orifice law, finite isolated stock and known temperature/volume evolution. Apart from the source 0.5 A reference, these values are introduced rather than measured material, sensor or actuator properties.

Construction obligations
A useful complete restoration operation must couple actual damage detection to local repair, preserve or isolate the mechanical/fluid load, locate the heat where it is needed, avoid destroying healthy monitor paths, recover a bounded cool state, and verify useful function. Missing material and consumed/reconfigured conductive stock need explicit restoration or replacement. A new cartridge or externally refreshed layer is paid input, not an internally renewed state. Ordinary local sensing, isolation and proof loading are available candidate components, not claimed new inventions.
